item.description:
英伟达明天将发布报告。

但更大的问题可能不是盈利。

问题在于多年来对该股的正确判断是否让投资者不再愿意质疑它。

最难卖出的股票往往是让你感觉最聪明的股票。

我最新的@Barchart：$NVDA https://www.barchart.com/story/news/8864604/nvidia-is-down-30-do-you-own-the-stock-or-does-the-stock-own-you

Nvidia reports tomorrow.

But the bigger question may not be earnings.

It’s whether years of being right about the stock have made investors less willing to question it.

The hardest stock to sell is often the one that made you feel smartest.

item.title: RT: 股价下跌 50% 的价格仍然可能很高。 旧的高潮告诉你它在哪里。它没有告诉你它的价值。
item.description:
股价下跌 50% 的价格仍然可能很高。

旧的高潮告诉你它在哪里。它没有告诉你它的价值。

我并不试图抓住确切的底部。我等待期望变得比业务更糟糕。

我最新的@Barchart
https://www.barchart.com/story/news/8957624/a-stock-down-50-can-still-be-expense-heres-how-i-look-for-a-bottom

A stock down 50% can still be expensive.

The old high tells you where it’s been. It tells you nothing about what it’s worth.

I don’t try to catch the exact bottom. I wait for expectations to get worse than the business.

My latest for @Barchart
https://www.barchart.com/story/news/8957624/a-stock-down-50-can-still-be-expensive-heres-how-i-look-for-a-bottom
